designThesis: Movements Board: harbour tide/movements chalkboard commits passages via permanent chalk-entry head strip + Ctrl+Enter stamp into dense ruled log; refuse KPI dashboard, maps, and fintech gradients.
subjectGrounding: Passage Log Console; harbour masters logging vessel passages; desktop web app; vessel, inbound/outbound, timestamp, berth note; form->save->row; empty/validation/success/offline; Ctrl+Enter; near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber warnings only; imageless; density 8, motion 1, boldness 3; no KPIs/logos; anti fintech gradients and playful illustration chrome.
composition: Full-width desktop board: thin status rail (title + offline banner); always-on chalk-entry head strip (vessel, IN/OUT, time, berth note, Save + Ctrl+Enter); majority-height dense chronological ruled body. Not hero/KPI dashboard.
informationHierarchy: 1) Chalk-entry head strip (required fields + Save) 2) Offline/validation amber signal 3) Ruled passage board body. No decorative metrics or logos.
typography: Neutral UI workhorse sans for labels; tabular figures for times; short operational labels; compact density-8 scale; no display/poster face.
colourAndMaterialModel: Restrained night-watch: near-black shell; fog-grey chalkboard panels; chalk-light ink; signal amber only for offline banner and validation errors. No purple/fintech gradients; no nixie-orange brand glow.
imageryAndAssetStrategy: Deliberately imageless — UI chrome and type are the content; asset manifest none.
interactionConcept: Land -> focus vessel -> fill required -> Save or Ctrl+Enter -> success row on board -> next entry. Motion intensity 1: state changes only. States: empty, validation, success row, offline banner.
signatureElement: Chalk-entry head strip + Ctrl+Enter stamp — permanent rewriteable first line of the movements board; direction as short IN/OUT marks on strip and rows.
primaryRisk: Density 8 without imagery collapses into generic dark admin CRUD if chalk-entry strip and amber-only fault discipline are not held; literal nixie orange glow or Ikeda pure-B/W strobe would violate brand and anti-references.
implementationGuidance: Build Movements Board only from NATIVE.md: near-black shell, fog-grey board, amber warn-only, imageless; permanent entry strip + dense ruled body; states empty/validation/success/offline; Ctrl+Enter; short operational labels; density 8 / motion 1 / boldness 3. No KPIs, maps, logos, fintech gradients, or illustration chrome. Seed key h2h-passage-2026-07-31; assigned grounded #6 tide/movements chalkboard; poolRevision 94ff10ff20de; alternates A1 barcode-density log (Ikeda fuse), A2 fixed-place time bank without orange glow (Nixie fuse).
unknowns: Timestamp defaulting (manual vs system clock); exact requiredness of berth note; validation rule detail beyond requiredness; multi-user concurrency; offline sync behaviour beyond banner; non-desktop breakpoints beyond quality floor.
